respuesta.razonamiento: Merged visual and spoken readings into an 8-node graph. The visual diagram contains UserCompanyDeveloper, Lambda, SQS, two Fargate tasks (a worker and the Compute Engine), EC2 (transcribed as CC2 in narration), Aurora database, and third-party Elasticsearch. GitHub and standalone UI/API endpoints mentioned in speech are omitted as separate nodes because the whiteboard represents the trigger directly from the developer to Lambda, and UI/API interactions happen directly with the EC2 host. Duplicate visual detections between Fargate/EC2 and Aurora were deduplicated. Interactions are organized into three flows: asynchronous code analysis ingestion (Flow 0), report computation and indexing (Flow 1), and report querying by developers (Flow 2).
respuesta.nombre: Asynchronous Code Analysis and Reporting Architecture

nodes.notes: Pulls reports from database and processes them

nodes.name: EC2
nodes.notes: Receives reports via API and serves UI/API queries
